notes:
Lead: Head of Product (Anika Shah) — product team building in-app assistant + semantic search. Initial onboarding via Hosted API kicked off Oct-2025 (trial).
Saw 1st demo Nov-2025 — liked low-latency streaming, function calling. Feb-2026: decision to test Dedicated for predictable throughput and VPC isolation.

POC scope: 4-week Dedicated POC focused on a single customer-facing microservice (conversational assist) with canary rollout and routing fallbacks. POC goals: prove 95th-p50 latency <= 250ms for 512-token chats, sustain 120 reqs/sec at 50% concurrency without cost > target.

Technical requirements / asks from Solarium:
- VPC peering + private egress (cannot send logs to public buckets; prefer S3 in us-east-1 with encryption)
- SSO via Okta (SAML) + role mapping for engineers and ops
- Audit logging retention 90 days, exportable to customer SIEM
- KMS integration for model keys and optional HSM for secrets

Routing / reliability plan discussed on call 2026-02-18:
- Canary: route 5% traffic to new Dedicated model variant for 48h; gradual ramp to 25% then 50% based on error and latency metrics.
- Fallbacks: primary -> dedicated-small-quant (int8 q4_0); fallback -> hosted-stable (same model family) in case of capacity or elevated error rate.
- Region failover: primary us-east-1, secondary us-west-2 (cold standby). RTO target: <2 min for route switch; automated via routing policy tied to health checks.
- Rollback policy: automated rollback trigger if 5xx rate >0.5% or p95 latency increase >30% sustained 10 min. Manual override via Redwood Console.

Commercial / pricing notes:
- Solarium is cost-sensitive: target blended cost per 1k tokens < $6 (goal). Interested in Optimize recommendations and quantization guidance.
- Asking for an appendix with Dedicated commit tiers (monthly 3-month trial tier, 6/12 mo discounts) + overage rates. Redwood pricing deck shared (drive link).
